description: 45 standard extended-I precast bridge beams proposed by Marinelli et al. (Frontiers in Built Environment 6:119, 2020, open access) from 2,284 as-built beams on the Egnatia Motorway: 15 lengths (22.00-43.00 m in 1.5 m steps) x 3 effective-deck-width classes (2.0/2.5/3.0 m). Depth law (paper eq. 1): D = -0.303 + 0.047*L + 0.248*Weff (m). Widths constant: top flange 1400, bottom flange 750. Web width by depth: 300 (D<=1.60), 320 (1.60<D<=1.90), 340 (D>1.90).

sources.note: The paper's Table 6 publishes lengths, depths and flange widths only. Flange THICKNESSES are intentionally left to the designer (the paper standardises L, D and widths); they are REQUIRED constructor arguments here rather than assumed.
